name: smwsprites-giant-thwomp
title: Giant Thwomp
description:
This is a Giant Thwomp, which is a larger version of the infamous Thwomp. It attempts to crush the player if they get near it. Comes with a version with goes upwards as well.

Isikoro's Update
Updated to look in the direction of movement. (It can also be made to make the eyes look down as before.)
The arrangement of tile numbers used was divided for face and body.
